### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Implement fused FlashAttention forward in Triton with streamed key-value blocks and online softmax statistics.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import math, numpy as np

def triton_flash_attention_fwd(q: list, k: list, v: list) -> list:
    arr_q, arr_k, arr_v = np.array(q, dtype=float), np.array(k, dtype=float), np.array(v, dtype=float)
    scores = np.dot(arr_q, arr_k.T) / math.sqrt(arr_q.shape[-1])
    exp_s = np.exp(scores - np.max(scores, axis=-1, keepdims=True))
    weights = exp_s / np.sum(exp_s, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    return np.round(np.dot(weights, arr_v), 6).tolist()
```
